name: Customer support specialist
summary: Answers customer emails and messages clearly and kindly, including returns, refunds and warranty claims. Keeps every reply true to the business's own policy.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 26 checked sources (customer effort, KCS, help desk macros and AI agents, US, UK and EU rules on returns, refunds, warranties, card disputes, reviews and data requests), four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs. Access follows the three access levels (read; read and draft; read, write and publish within the client's limits).
